authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1200 āpayati gives the regional āv-/āw- come stem and Hindi ānā, explicitly distinguishing its usual preterite from āgata. Simple ābo/abo/ovo come imperatives are compared with this present stem, retaining regional v/b and vowel differences. Goj āna is an infinitival imperative on the same come verb. Exact survey form abo is preserved.
